destination.title: Holographic descriptions, dynamics and gravitational information
destination.question: Which holographic descriptions and calculations illuminate field theory, gravitating systems, cosmology and vacuum scales, and how do their specific assumptions limit observable calculations and consistency claims?
destination.summary: Organize dictionaries, information, dynamics, cosmology and conditional consistency tests without treating numerical ancestry as scientific equivalence. Holography-inspired proposals remain distinguishable from calculations using a specified boundary/bulk dictionary.

Vacuum and particle sectors coupled to proposed quantum-gravity structures

Cosmological histories, boundaries, entropy and transitions

sources.title: Higher derivative effects on eta/s at finite chemical potential

evidence.text: Does a finite U(1)R chemical potential modify η/s once supersymmetric four-derivative corrections are included, and does it strengthen or weaken violation of the proposed 1/(4π) viscosity bound?

sources.title: Exotic holographic RG flows at finite temperature

evidence.text: How do finite-temperature states modify exotic holographic RG flows with skipping, bounces or irrelevant-operator vevs, and what do their thermodynamics imply about phase structure, vacuum moduli and consistency?

sources.title: Holographic Naturalness

evidence.text: Can intrinsic holographic vacuum entropy and gravitational interaction with hidden quantum hairs stabilize the cosmological constant and Higgs hierarchy, and motivate observable effective decoherence without a new collider-scale Higgs completion?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Holography replaces selected strongly coupled field-theory questions with gravitational ones. Its classical use invokes large N, strong coupling and weak bulk curvature; these conditions delimit the calculational laboratory discussed in the window.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can all subsystem entropies of one holographic state determine its classical bulk geometry? The proposed advantage over null-endpoint data is sensitivity to the metric's conformal factor and access to deeper bulk regions.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can entanglement between otherwise noninteracting boundary theories explain nonzero correlations associated with a connected multiple-boundary bulk wormhole?

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared corrections violate the conjectured KSS bound η/s ≥ 1/(4π), and do violations correlate with bulk pathologies, inconsistent boundary theories, or restrictions on quantum-gravity embeddings?

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Does reducing shear viscosity in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic model eventually violate boundary microcausality, thereby imposing a consistency-related lower bound on η/s?

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Can a simple gravitational model describe a strongly coupled 2+1-dimensional system with a charged condensate, a superconducting transition and a gap in its frequency-dependent conductivity?

sources.title: Random versus holographic fluctuations of the background metric. I. (Cosmological) running of space-time dimension

evidence.text: Can finite spacetime resolution explain scale-dependent dimension reduction, and can the resulting correction to Newtonian gravity distinguish random from holographic metric fluctuations?

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: How do gravitational backreaction and arbitrary scalar charge affect holographic condensation and transport, and what magnetic response, critical fields and photon mass follow from the model?

sources.title: Real time response on dS(3): The Topological AdS Black Hole and the Bubble

evidence.text: How do real-time correlators distinguish the topological black hole and bubble phases of strongly coupled N=4 SYM on dS3 × S1, reveal cosmological thermal effects, and characterize charge relaxation?

sources.title: Landscape versus Swampland for Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can consistency requirements on holographic boundary theories distinguish negative-cosmological-constant Gauss–Bonnet gravity theories belonging to the string landscape from those in the swampland, and what do these examples imply for viscosity bounds?

sources.title: Holographic Hydrodynamics with a Chemical Potential

evidence.text: How do general four-derivative bulk interactions change finite-chemical-potential thermodynamics, shear viscosity and conductivity, and what happens to conjectured transport bounds?

sources.title: Emergent quantum criticality, Fermi surfaces, and AdS(2)

evidence.text: How does the near-horizon geometry control low-frequency retarded correlators, Fermi-surface excitations and possible instabilities of strongly coupled finite-density systems?

sources.title: Strong Coupling Holography

evidence.text: Does the bulk holographic scale for N species constrain the strong-coupling scale of their four-dimensional brane theory, including limits that decouple gravity and examples without an AdS near-horizon geometry?

sources.title: No Forbidden Landscape in String/M-theory

evidence.text: Does holographic consistency exclude string/M-theory backgrounds dual to scale-invariant but nonconformal field theories, and can this exclusion constrain compactifications and higher-derivative effective actions?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric infrared perturbations to the warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: Which isometry-preserving infrared perturbations of Klebanov–Strassler break supersymmetry, which can represent localized SUSY-breaking 3-brane sources, and what do their fluxes and geometry imply for the effective gravitino mass?

sources.title: Towards strange metallic holography

evidence.text: Can controlled holographic models of finite-density, gapped charge carriers coupled to a neutral Lifshitz critical sector reproduce anomalous DC, optical, and Hall transport associated with strange metals?

sources.title: Holography and wormholes in 2+1 dimensions

evidence.text: How does real-time holography encode topology hidden behind horizons when every outer region is a static BTZ exterior? The apparent mismatch is between m exterior mass parameters and 6g−6+3m surface moduli in the general construction.

sources.title: Micromanaging de Sitter holography

evidence.text: Can uplifting Freund-Rubin AdS/CFT constructions provide microscopic realizations of metastable de Sitter holography and account for the parametric scaling of Gibbons-Hawking entropy?

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit useful weakly coupled holographic descriptions, and why would factorization and CFT consistency naturally lead an observer to introduce AdS fields and Witten diagrams?

sources.title: Constructing local bulk observables in interacting AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can CFT operators represent interacting bulk observables beyond leading large N while satisfying bulk locality, defined as commutation at spacelike separation?

sources.title: Probing AdS Wormholes by Entanglement Entropy

evidence.text: What do holographic entanglement entropy and probe-brane conductivity reveal about the dual interpretation of a smooth Lorentzian geometry connecting an AdS region to flat space, particularly the expected entanglement between its two asymptotic regions?

sources.title: The Shear Viscosity to Entropy Ratio: A Status Report

evidence.text: What explains holographic universality of η/s, how do higher-curvature, finite-N and finite-coupling effects violate or preserve the KSS bound, and can microscopic consistency impose a replacement lower bound?

sources.title: Bulk and Transhorizon Measurements in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can effective bulk observables, including measurements behind an AdS black-hole horizon, be represented in the dual CFT? In particular, can the CFT encode a measurement distinguishing a live from a dead cat behind the horizon?

sources.title: Construction of Bulk Fields with Gauge Redundancy

evidence.text: How can boundary-operator smearing reconstruct gauge and gravitational bulk fields, and what physical meaning and locality remain after gauge fixing and imposing Gauss-law constraints?

sources.title: Holographic representation of bulk fields with spin in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can bulk spin-one and spin-two fields be represented as smeared CFT operators, and which notions of locality survive gauge redundancy, interactions in 1/N perturbation theory, and extensions beyond a fixed AdS background?

sources.title: The Gravity Dual of a Density Matrix

evidence.text: Given a boundary subregion density matrix ρ_A in a state with a classical geometric AdS/CFT dual, what is the largest bulk region fully reconstructible from it, equivalently common to all geometric duals compatible with that density matrix?

sources.title: Non-relativistic holography from Horava gravity

evidence.text: What bulk gravitational field content and gauge symmetries can holographically represent generic nonrelativistic QFTs with conserved particle number, and can the resulting dictionary reproduce the correlation-function structure required by nonrelativistic conformal symmetry?

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: The authors report agreement among four methods: Kubo and stretched-horizon calculations nonperturbative in λGB, plus shear diffusion and sound attenuation poles at linear order. The membrane calculation uses Kaluza-Klein reduction to a generalized Maxwell action.

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Expand the action to quadratic order in h₁₂, Fourier transform as e^{−iωt+iqx₃}, and obtain its radial wave equation. The retarded stress-tensor correlator gives η in the small-frequency, small-momentum limit.

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Compute zero-spatial-momentum conductivity from an Ax perturbation with e^{-iωt} dependence and ingoing horizon boundary conditions. Use its boundary coefficients for linear response and Kramers–Kronig relations to associate an imaginary pole with a real conductivity delta function.

sources.title: Random versus holographic fluctuations of the background metric. I. (Cosmological) running of space-time dimension

evidence.text: Random fluctuations are modeled by independent errors of either sign with equal probability. Counting Planck four-volume cells gives a square-root, Poisson-type accumulation of the volume uncertainty.

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: Solve the fully backreacted radial equations by numerical shooting from a regular horizon, imposing source-free scalar boundary conditions. Compare equilibrium free energies using the regulated Euclidean action with gravitational and scalar boundary counterterms.

sources.title: Axionic Dark Radiation and the Milky Way's Magnetic Field

evidence.text: Could relativistic axionic dark radiation convert in the Milky Way magnetic field strongly enough to explain ROSAT soft X-ray backgrounds or emission above and below the Galactic centre, and which axion parameters would overproduce those signals?

sources.title: Monodromy Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can axion monodromy relax the abundance restrictions linking misalignment-produced dark matter masses and couplings, and when do residual periodic wiggles change homogeneous evolution or amplify fluctuations?

sources.title: Dark Matter Axions Revisited

evidence.text: For which Peccei–Quinn scale fa, inflationary Hubble parameter HI and initial angle θi can invisible axions supply all cold dark matter, including corrections from potential anharmonicity?

sources.title: Non-gaussianity in axion N-flation models: detailed predictions and mass spectra

evidence.text: What probability distributions and correlations of the scalar tilt, tensor ratio, bispectrum and trispectrum arise in axion N-flation, and how tightly must unequal masses be packed to satisfy the observational constraints used in the paper?

sources.title: Bosenova collapse of axion cloud around a rotating black hole

evidence.text: Does nonlinear axion self-interaction saturate a superradiantly growing cloud around a rotating black hole, or cause bosenova collapse? What controls the onset and subsequent energy redistribution?

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Can conversion of a primordial cosmic axion background in Coma's magnetic field reproduce both the luminosity and radial morphology of its soft X-ray excess, and what conditional restrictions follow for the axions and their production?

sources.title: Natural and Multi-Natural Inflation in Axion Landscape

evidence.text: Can accidental alignment among many axions with sub-Planckian decay constants produce a sufficiently flat, super-Planckian inflationary direction, and connect slow-roll inflation after tunneling to the numbers of axions and symmetry-breaking sources?

sources.title: ALP Conversion and the Soft X-ray Excess in the Outskirts of the Coma Cluster

evidence.text: Can conversion of a homogeneous cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and radial morphology of Coma's outskirts soft X-ray excess with parameters compatible with the earlier central-region analysis?

sources.title: A Cosmic ALP Background and the Cluster Soft X-ray Excess in A665, A2199 and A2255

evidence.text: Can a cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and morphology of the soft X-ray excesses in A2199 and A2255 while remaining compatible with the absence of an observed excess in A665?

sources.title: Widening the Axion Window via Kinetic and Stückelberg Mixings

evidence.text: Can kinetic and Stückelberg mixing widen effective axion decay constants beyond the intrinsic scales suggested by the original Lagrangian, yielding either a super-Planckian inflationary coupling or a smaller decay constant in the conventional axion dark-matter window?

sources.title: Cosmic axion background propagation in galaxies

evidence.text: Can a diffuse cosmic ALP background produce observable photons through conversion in the Milky Way or starburst galaxies, and how do magnetic structure, plasma clumping, and photoelectric absorption determine the signal?

sources.title: Multiple-axion framework

evidence.text: Can a systematic treatment of many-axion potentials identify their vacuum structure and support metastability, inflation, a small cosmological constant, and ultralight axion dark matter within one effective framework?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Which observations could probe the light axions discussed here? The source highlights substructure, superradiance, and direct-detection experiments as prospective channels sensitive to axion mass and decay constant.

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: A hidden strongly interacting sector is used to generate a dark-energy scale from the electroweak and Planck scales while furnishing an axion with the shift symmetry needed by the supergravity construction.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can an axion oscillating about a positive minimum produce observable departures from constant dark energy? The proposed low-redshift comparison concerns masses comparable to the present Hubble rate.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can an ultralight periodic axion provide evolving dark energy when its potential minimum is not fixed to zero? Hubble friction delays motion until H approaches the axion mass, while the initial phase and vacuum offset affect subsequent evolution.

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Could an electroweak axion with a potential scale different from the dark-energy scale serve as ultralight matter? The paper raises this possibility but does not identify a viable mass and abundance regime.

sources.title: The Spectrum of the Axion Dark Sector, Cosmological Observable and Black Hole Superradiance Constraints

evidence.text: How can astrophysical black-hole mass and spin measurements constrain the number of ultralight axions and the central masses and widths of statistical mass distributions motivated by axion alignment and compactified M-theory?

sources.title: Axion Hilltops, Kahler Modulus Quintessence and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a coupling modulus supply the gradient missing at an axion hilltop, and can the resulting positive-energy motion describe dark energy within the effective theory of a supersymmetric AdS vacuum?

sources.title: Tackling the SDC in AdS with CFTs

evidence.text: What becomes light as the axio-dilaton approaches weak coupling at fixed five-dimensional LMPl? This fixes the flux integer and excludes varying the stabilized breathing mode.

sources.title: Cosmic axion background

evidence.text: Can relativistic axions constitute a detectable cosmic axion background (CaB), with source-dependent spectra accessible by repurposing instruments and data designed for nonrelativistic axion dark matter?

sources.title: Superradiance in string theory

evidence.text: Can astrophysical black-hole masses and spins exclude regions of type IIB Calabi–Yau moduli space through axion superradiance, accounting for self-interactions while avoiding assumptions about axion relic abundance?

sources.title: Axion homeopathy: screening dilaton interactions

evidence.text: Can a light axion with very weak matter coupling use curved target-space interactions to screen a gravitational-strength dilaton coupling sufficiently to evade solar-system post-Newtonian constraints?

sources.title: Axio-Chameleons: a novel string-friendly multi-field screening mechanism

evidence.text: Can two-derivative axion-dilaton interactions screen an extremely light Brans-Dicke scalar with microscopic coupling g of order unity, while retaining control of the low-energy theory and acceptable axion-matter phenomenology?

sources.title: Mass and force relations for extremal Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton-axion black holes

evidence.text: How does an axion change extremal dyonic black-hole mass relations and the connection between long-range forces and binding energies? Can interactions between non-identical states reveal possible UV constraints beyond conjectures formulated for self-forces?

sources.title: Impact of First-order Electroweak Phase Transition on QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can a temporary axion-mass contribution associated with a first-order electroweak transition change misalignment dynamics enough to obtain QCD-axion dark matter over a wider decay-constant range, while producing a potentially detectable gravitational-wave signal?

sources.title: Astrophysical aspects of string compactifications

evidence.text: Can an axion gradient, generated by different effective minima inside and outside a neutron star, screen the macroscopic Brans–Dicke coupling of a kinetically coupled dilaton? The immediate task is numerical stellar profiles and a diagnostic for subsequent screening measurement.

sources.title: Search for solar Kaluza-Klein axions in theories of low scale quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can a terrestrial detector observe solar Kaluza–Klein (KK) axions through coincident two-photon decays, and what coupling sensitivity and existing limits follow in low-scale quantum-gravity models?

sources.title: Dark Matter Axions Revisited

evidence.text: Average θi²f(θi) uniformly over [−π,π] after inflation, obtaining 8.77 with the adopted anharmonic factor. During inflation use a single background angle plus variance σθ²=(HI/(2πfa))².

sources.title: Non-gaussianity in axion N-flation models: detailed predictions and mass spectra

evidence.text: Numerical field evolution is repeated over random initial angles to estimate observable distributions and correlations. The detailed equal-mass distribution uses 100 realizations at f=MP, N*=50, Nf=2150; unequal-mass parameter maps generally average ten realizations per sampled point.

sources.title: Bosenova collapse of axion cloud around a rotating black hole

evidence.text: An auxiliary nonrelativistic model treats gravity through a Newtonian potential and the cloud as a time-dependent Gaussian wavepacket. Its radial width, angular width and peak radius become collective coordinates; an effective potential and normal-mode analysis describe equilibria and oscillations.

sources.title: Axionic Dark Radiation and the Milky Way's Magnetic Field

evidence.text: Numerically evolve a damped density matrix from a pure axion state along 30 kpc trajectories ending at the Solar System, 8.5 kpc from the Galactic centre. Photon attenuation uses gas distributions and an energy-dependent absorption cross section per hydrogen atom.

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Generate a random vector potential with Rayleigh-distributed amplitudes, uniform phases, and power proportional to k^-n; take its Fourier-space curl and transform to a Gaussian tangled magnetic field. Apply infrared/ultraviolet cutoffs and a radial density-dependent modulation.

sources.title: Natural and Multi-Natural Inflation in Axion Landscape

evidence.text: Numerical eigenvalue distributions exclude det A = 0. With eigenvalues ai² ordered increasingly, the estimated enhancement is feff/f ≃ ⟨a⟩/a1, where ⟨a⟩ is the square root of the mean eigenvalue. One reported ensemble contains 10^5 matrices with Naxion = 10 and n = 2.

sources.title: Bounding axion dark energy

evidence.text: What analytic restrictions relate axion couplings, initial conditions and the duration of declining cosmic acceleration, and what do these imply for axion dark energy when observational endpoints and the axionic weak gravity conjecture are imposed?

sources.title: Discovering the QCD Axion with Black Holes and Gravitational Waves

evidence.text: Can black-hole superradiance reveal high-decay-constant QCD axions through gravitational waves from cloud transitions or annihilations, and what constraints follow from black-hole spins or null GW searches?
